master-of-fate.success: You know the right way. The table describes it.

filthy-fingersmith.success: Success with pockets and locks; resolve the fictional change at the table.
filthy-fingersmith.failure: Failed to pick pockets or locks.

list-of-sins.success: Strange light surrounds evil creatures. Defend with +2 against beings discovered this way; apply the benefit manually.

horn-of-the-schleswig-lords.success: The chosen creature's next non-combat test is an automatic success. Apply the benefit manually.
horn-of-the-schleswig-lords.failure: The horn grants no automatic success.

stones-taken-from-thel-emas-lost-temple.success: The stones tell the truth about danger in the adjacent room. The table supplies the answer.
stones-taken-from-thel-emas-lost-temple.failure: The stones may lie. Cannot test again until sunset; the table restores eligibility manually.

ezumiels-vapor.text: DR14 test or severe hallucinations for %d hours. The source does not select a PC ability; the table chooses and resolves that test. Handle hallucinations manually.

southern-frog-stew.text: Vomit for %d hours. DR14 test or do nothing else. The source does not select a PC ability; the table chooses and resolves that test. Handle vomiting manually.

fernors-philtre.text: Cures infection and gives +2 on Presence tests for %d hours. Dab into the eye; handle these benefits manually.

spider-owl-soup.text: See in darkness and climb walls for 30 minutes. Handle these benefits manually.

hyphos-enervating-snuff.text: Two attacks per round, defence DR14 for one fight. Snort the snuff; sneezing and these benefits are handled manually.

speaker-of-truths.text: The chosen creature's next test DR is lowered by 4. Apply this benefit manually.

harp.text: Music gives +%d on the reaction roll. Apply the benefit manually.

excretal-stealth.text: When hidden in muck, debris and filth, noticing you requires Presence DR16. Resolve observers' tests manually.

escaping-fate.text: Each Omen use has a 50% chance not to spend it. Resolve the chance and Omen benefit manually, using ordinary dice and sheet corrections. No Omen benefit is automated.

crumpled-monster-mask.text: While worn, lesser creatures such as goblins, gnoums and children check Morale every round. Resolve these ongoing checks manually.
